title: How to memorize the branches of the Internal Carotid Artery (ICA)?
content: Hi everyone! I am struggling to recall all the branches of the cerebral part of the Internal Carotid Artery for my upcoming MEC-UG entrance. Does anyone have a solid, high-yield clinical mnemonic?

replies.content:
Hey Sunil! Yes, a classic high-yield mnemonic we use is: **'A Professional Surgeon Ought Many Pretty Clinical Things'**.

- **A**: Anterior Choroidal Artery
- **P**: Posterior Communicating Artery
- **S**: Superior Hypophyseal Artery
- **O**: Ophthalmic Artery
- **M**: Middle Cerebral Artery (terminal branch)
- **A**: Anterior Cerebral Artery (terminal branch)

This covers the cerebral segment branches perfectly. Keep focused on the Ophthalmic branch, they love asking about it in licensing exams!
This is super elegant! Thanks Prof. Ramesh. Memorizing this mnemonic made it so simple.

title: MEC-PG Eligibility & Internship Guidelines for 2026
content: Is there any official update from the Medical Education Commission (MEC) regarding internship duration completion requirements for PG eligibility this year? Do we need exactly 12 months completed before registering?

replies.content: Hello Dr. Niranjan. Yes, the current guidelines mandate that candidates must complete exactly 1 year (12 months) of regular rotatory internship and register with the NMC (temporary/permanent licensing) by the deadline specified in the application call. There are no exemptions as of the latest committee meeting.
